cohort: Women who delivered during a four-month period at Port Moresby General Hospital
finding: The actual cesarean section rate (5.5%) was lower than the WHO C-Model predicted rate (8%), suggesting an underutilization of cesarean sections, particularly among high-risk Robson groups.
mod_finding: This study investigated ideal Cesarean section rates using the WHO C-Model and found that the actual Cesarean section rate was lower than the model's estimated rate.
